text:
maya: Zenith just sent final allocation terms for EU edge H100s — 6-8w lead, price +12%, commit hold window until Fri EOD. Paste of their excerpt below, need quick callouts.
zenith-sales: We can offer 30% immediate ship, 70% backfill on a 90d option. Expedited lane available at +$1.2k/unit for 2-week air. Split-AWB recommended for customs mitigation.
maya: ugh. Can procurement push on the price tiers? splitting the AWB adds ops overhead but may save time.
sam: price delta is ~€2.2k/unit after duties. If we sign by Friday we secure the 30% top-off at the current band.
linh: ops question: FRA depot is at 92% staging capacity next 10 days — split AWB might overflow docks. Can we route some to NL hold yard?
diego: I asked logistics. NL yard has room but needs carrier change (extra $250/ship). Also vendor warned about serialized manifest for RMA — they prefer returns routed back to vendor depot in FRA to speed RMA credit.
ops-bot: Alert: eu-west-1 reserved pool at 79% (24h avg). Projected to hit 85% in 5 days under current burn.
linh: if we take only 30% now, we should throttle non-critical training jobs and shift experiments to us-west spare capacity. @sam can you quantify cost delta for cross-region shift?
sam: quick estimate: ~+15% infra cost for those jobs (egress + spot pricing). If we avoid emergency airlift that's cheaper than expedite fee.
maya: preference: push for tiered commit (30% now at current price, remainder at price band with max cap) + vendor covers one-way split-AWB fee if we commit 90d option. @zenith-sales please confirm if you can absorb split-AWB fee.
zenith-sales: We can cover up to $300/airwaybill on split-AWB if customer signs 90d backfill option. Expedited fee still on customer.
linh: ok, that helps. On RMA: can we pre-generate vendor return labels to avoid depot delays? Package labeling + manifest template below.
linh: ```
RMA_LABEL_TYPE: RETURN_TO_VENDOR_FRA
MANIFEST_FIELDS: serial, rma_id, shipper, carrier
SPECIAL: split_awb=true
```
diego: Logistics will pre-stage labels but we need vendor to accept temp serial mapping for new serials arriving (vendor promised a 48h reconciliation window).
zenith-sales: we can accept temp-serials for 72h to help staging, must reconcile before credit is issued.
maya: next steps: 1) @sam confirm cost of shifting workload by EOD. 2) @diego confirm NL yard carrier options + $/unit. 3) @zenith-sales please send formal PO snippet with tiered commit and split-AWB fee commitment. 4) ops to prepare pre-generated RMA labels.
sam: on it. I'll ping with quick numbers within 3h. :+1:
diego: I'll run carrier quotes now, target 2-4h.
zenith-sales: will send PO draft before EOD Fri. Expecting signature timeline?
maya: aim to have legal review + sign by Thu if procurement ok. if not, we default to no commit and longer lead.
linh: flagged for SRE triage — will start shifting low-pri queues after sam's numbers. 
maya: thanks all — tldr: pursue tiered commit with vendor concession on split-AWB fee, avoid expedite if possible, prep RMA label flow. Follow-up thread after PO arrives.
